titolo: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go: dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机本机运行，也能遥控你的电脑。
descr: Community‑built DSH Go brings DeepSeek Harness to Android, offering on‑device Linux, model switching and SSH/DSH remote access.
paragrafi: The open‑source project DSH Go, hosted on GitHub, provides an Android client for DeepSeek Harness, allowing the engine to run directly on a phone.
The app includes a built‑in Ubuntu and Node.js environment, requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer, and offers both local execution and remote connection via SSH or DSH Remote.
The client supports chat, image sending, voice input, plugin cards, and screen‑control features, with permissions clearly explained for screen reading and input automation.
DSH Go is released under AGPL‑3.0 (with MIT‑licensed SDK/examples), and the developers note it is an unofficial community project with no affiliation to DeepSeek.
perche: Running DeepSeek Harness on a phone removes the need for a separate Linux host, useful for developers who want a portable LLM interface. For users preferring free or locally hosted models, DSH Go offers a way to experiment without paying for cloud services, while still allowing remote access to more powerful machines when needed.
